fact: The PNDS 2021-2025, dated October 2021, states that DHIS 2 for routine data is deployed in all regional and departmental health directorates, CHR, general hospitals and a few ESPC, and its costed action plan carries yearly lines of 30 million FCFA from 2021 to 2025 for integrating private-sector, EPN and other data into the SIG (DHIS 2) and for DHIS 2 interoperability; the same plan describes the Dossier Patient Informatisé as under trial in one hospital and budgets 31 million FCFA a year to dematerialise collection tools including the patient record.
title: Plan National de Développement Sanitaire 2021-2025
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène Publique et de la Couverture Maladie Universelle
